up: List all distinct compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID CHEMBL5727344. For each compound, provide the compound's ChEMBL identifier (from molecule_dictionary), its preferred name (if any), and its canonical SMILES (if available). Include compounds only if they are linked to this specific document via the compound_records table (using doc_id). Do not filter by activity type, assay, or target; simply return the compounds directly associated with the document. If a compound has no structure, still include it but with NULL for SMILES.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS compound_chembl_id, md.pref_name, cs.canonical_smiles
FROM docs d
JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5727344';
